dataset.description:
This data includes the processed structure factors for diffraction images collected on protein crystals relevant to the project, as well as the refined structural models.

The data will be deposited on the protein data bank (PDB, https://www.rcsb.org/). Data will be made accessible together with a pre-print manuscript pertinent to the project results.

distribution.title: The data is generated to elucidated the structural level of the biomolecular system being studied. In the connect of the project, this involves determining the structure of STAT1 in complex with designed peptides. The data improves our understanding of how biological molecules interact.

dataset.title: X-ray crystallographic diffraction data

dmp.description: The DMP outlines the various kinds of data that will be generated in the project Pathogen-inspired peptide macrocycles as STAT1 antagonists and describes how the data is collected, stored and made accessible.
